prompts.prompt: Create one premium narrative PAINTING for a Kalistar trading card, vertical 4:5 composition. Subject: VAMP from METAL GEAR SOLID 2: SONS OF LIBERTY in his iconic boss encounter inside Big Shell's water filtration chamber. Accurate MGS2 appearance: adult lean muscular man, angular gaunt pale olive face, slicked-back long BLACK hair, pronounced widow's peak, sharp arched eyebrows, narrow moustache and pointed black goatee, a small old forehead scar, piercing eyes with normal human proportions. He wears his MGS2 long dark olive-green open TRENCH COAT with high collar, long sleeves and flowing divided tails, bare muscular chest visible through its open front, fitted dark gray tactical trousers, leather belt and dark boots. NOT his MGS4 shirtless harness outfit, no cyborg armor. His emotional expression: a small threatening knowing half-smile, disturbingly calm confidence, gaze aimed toward the unseen challenger. Requested pose: FLOATING upright 50 centimetres ABOVE the WATER at the centre of the boss arena, both feet clearly not touching water or a platform, body subtly tilted, legs close and one ankle slightly in front, BOTH ARMS EXTENDED OUT to either side at shoulder height with softly bent elbows, an elegant predatory invitation. Hold one slender steel combat dagger in the right hand, straight blade clearly separated from fingers, other hand open naturally. Two arms, two hands, two legs only. Coat tails hanging and gently fanning above rippling water reinforce suspension, subtle reflection directly below. Environment must be an enclosed industrial water FILTRATION CHAMBER, large rectangular recessed basin of deep green/teal aerated water, narrow gridded metal catwalks along edges, weathered pale industrial walls, dark steel pillars and overhead beams, visible pipes, railings, small orange hazard paint and restrained red control lamps. Coherent architecture and perspective. No outdoor lake, no gothic cathedral, no crowded machinery, no fantasy throne. Camera on opposite catwalk looking slightly upward at his torso but still clearly sees water surface below his boots; entire figure and both hands fully visible. Face centred around x50%,y24%; head to boots occupy around 70% of height; hands and knife stay between x20% and x80% so card stat columns do not conceal them; leave lower water margin. Make the pose expressive and anatomically elegant rather than a stiff model T-pose. Kalistar golden-rule art direction: detailed narrative fantasy oil/digital painting, purposefully visible brushstrokes and broken edges, sculpted color planes on face and clothing, worn painted materials, richly differentiated cloth, skin, metal and water. Match the established Kalistar Momo/Valazar painterly family. Realistic anatomy and expressive individuality but unmistakably PAINTED, NOT a photograph, NOT smooth 3D render, NOT anime/manga, NOT cel shading. Cool industrial light reflected from the water shapes the face, restrained warm practical highlights in distance; face readable, background simplified enough for card size. The blood crystal is added separately by the card template: no glowing red crystal or magical aura in illustration, no gore. Illustration ONLY, no text, logos, symbols, numbers, UI, frame, border or watermark.
